adjudication.rationale: In addGuests.handler.ts the email sending is wrapped in a try/catch that only does `console.log("Error sending AddGuestsEmails")` and discards `err`, then the handler still returns success (`{ message: "Guests added" }`). This means email delivery failures are not observable/traceable and the client mutation will still hit `onSuccess` and show the success toast, even if emails failed.
